newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania says staff cuts to hit Q4.
newsitem.headline: Scania says staff cuts to hit Q4.

text.p: Swedish truck and bus maker Scania on Thursday said a staff reduction programme would hit fourth quarter profits by around 300 million crowns.

"To continue a staff reduction programme, as earlier announced, a programme will be introduced that is estimated to burden the fourth quarter by about 300 million crowns," Scania said in it report for the first nine months of 1996.
